name: TX-03
label: Likely R

key_factors: Incumbent Keith Self running with fundraising edge
No public polling of the race
model.rationale: The district's R+11 lean, Self's incumbency and fundraising advantage, and Polymarket pricing near 94% for Republicans all point to a comfortable Self win. Democrat Evan Hunt's modest fundraising gives little evidence of a serious challenge.
model.watch: Any late polling or outside spending targeting the district showing a Democratic surge would be the main signal to revisit.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
TX-03 is a solidly Republican Collin County seat with an R+11 partisan lean, and incumbent Keith Self is seeking reelection after easily securing his nomination. Self has out-raised Democrat Evan Hunt and holds a cash advantage, with outside groups spending modestly to support him. No public general-election polls are available, and no expert raters have flagged the race as competitive.

Prediction markets give Self roughly a 94% chance of winning, consistent with the district's fundamentals. Hunt's fundraising, while respectable for a challenger, appears insufficient to overcome the structural lean absent a major shift in the national environment.
